limitations: Four reused development seeds; no confirmatory inference or multiple-testing claim
One stronger frozen opponent this batch; previous study used two weaker opponents
Only three policy components activated; other feature families remain provisional
Same initial seed does not fix future shops after policy-induced RNG divergence
Refresh counterfactuals exclude preceding decay and assume treatment availability
Early cap collection is local; routing and all opportunity costs are not optimized

protocol.purpose: Development-only mechanistic features, 2x2x2 component and interaction study; no final feature selection

screening.screening_scope: availability, finite/schema, empirical variation, exact duplication and correlation; not predictive selection
screening.warning: Constants/duplicates are coverage flags, not rejection evidence; animal treatments lack rollout support.
